fact: A World Bank-financed (P180696) expression of interest published 24 September 2026 seeks an individual consultant to support implementation of Djibouti's electronic public procurement system (e-GP), including drafting specifications and e-GP tender documents.
title: Recruitment of an individual consultant for support in the implementation of the electronic public procurement system (e-GP)
publisher: Economic and Financial Governance Support Project (PAGEF), Djibouti
